From the test, the top-level call is `fake.password(length=8, special_chars=True, digits=True, upper_case=True, lower_case=True)`. In `Provider.password`, each true flag appends one token to `required_tokens`, so with all four flags true, `len(required_tokens) == 4`.

The loop in question is:

- initialize `random_indexes = set()`
- `while len(random_indexes) < len(required_tokens):`
- body: `random_indexes.add(self.generator.random.randint(0, len(chars) - 1))`

So I need the exact seeded random sequence for this call path, specifically how many `randint` draws are needed to accumulate 4 distinct indices in a set of positions `0..7`.

To verify the seeding path and whether `seed_instance` affects `self.generator.random` used here, I should read the relevant Faker proxy/generator seeding implementation next.
